{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, verify that only commas are used as separators
assert data['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).all() or not data['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any(), "Some rows have commas, others don't — inconsistent formatting"

# Strip commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("First 5 converted revenue values:", data['revenue'].head())
print("Data type of revenue after conversion:", data['revenue'].dtype)"}
